name: Aurore Lalucq - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive amending Directive 2011/16/EU on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the Commission's proposal without changes. The proposal lets multinational company groups file one tax report for the whole group instead of separate reports in each country. It sets up a standard form, based on the one agreed by the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework, and lets tax authorities exchange the information with each other. This is meant to cut paperwork for large groups and make the global minimum tax rules easier to apply. The Parliament asks the Council to consult it again if the text changes substantially.

- **What changes:** One shared tax report per group, using a standard form, with information exchanged between tax authorities.
- **Who it affects:** Large multinational and large domestic groups, about 4,000 entities instead of around 180,000 filing separately.
- **What happens next:** The Council must adopt the directive in time for the first reporting, due by 30 June 2026.
